stories.title: À l’aube de la campagne présidentielle, Emmanuel Macron expose aux candidats un décor de crises internationales

en.title: On the eve of the presidential campaign, Emmanuel Macron presents to candidates a backdrop of international crises
en.summary: France's president met with presidential candidates or their representatives at the Élysée Palace to discuss the implications of ongoing international crises in Ukraine and the Middle East.

stories.title: 🔴 Donald Trump annonce avoir obtenu un "contrôle permanent" sur la sécurité du Groenland

en.title: Donald Trump announces he has obtained "permanent control" over Greenland's security
en.summary: Donald Trump claimed to have secured permanent control over Greenland's security arrangements.

stories.title: Donald Trump annonce interdire l'accès à la Maison Blanche à trois médias dont la chaîne américaine CNN

en.title: Donald Trump announces ban on access to the White House for three media outlets including American channel CNN
en.summary: Trump announced restrictions on White House access for three news organizations, including CNN. The 80-year-old Republican has repeatedly criticized journalists and outlets whose coverage displeases him during his first term and since returning to power in 2025.

stories.title: Un adolescent de 15 ans proche de l'ultradroite mis en examen pour avoir projeté une attaque terroriste contre un lycée lyonnais

en.title: 15-year-old adolescent close to the far-right placed under examination for planning a terrorist attack against a Lyon high school
en.summary: A 15-year-old minor with far-right connections was charged with participating in an individual terrorist undertaking related to a planned attack on a Lyon school and placed under judicial supervision.

stories.title: Zinédine Zidane joue l’ouverture et mise sur la jeunesse pour sa première liste avec l’équipe de France

en.title: Zinédine Zidane opens up and banks on youth for his first squad list with the France team
en.summary: France's new coach unveiled his first squad selection on Friday, featuring 23 players including five new faces and notable changes while maintaining continuity with the previous approach.

stories.title: Donald Trump ne veut plus à la Maison Blanche des chaînes de télévision CNN et MSNOW ainsi que du média en ligne Politico

en.title: Donald Trump no longer wants CNN and MSNBC television networks and Politico online media at the White House
en.summary: The decision comes during a politically difficult period for Trump, marked by rising fuel prices and an ongoing conflict in Iran for which he says he cannot find a resolution.

stories.title: Rhône : un adolescent proche de l’extrême droite mis en examen pour avoir projeté une attaque contre son ancien lycée

en.title: Rhône: a teenager with far-right sympathies charged after planning an attack on his former high school
en.summary: A young man influenced by the assassination of an identitarian activist was arrested in Lyon and placed under judicial supervision at an educational facility after planning to attack students at a school that had expelled him.

stories.title: Donald Trump annonce interdire « avec effet immédiat » l’accès de la Maison Blanche aux chaînes CNN et MS NOW ainsi qu’à Politico

en.title: Donald Trump announces immediate ban on CNN and MSNBC access to the White House, as well as Politico
en.summary: The United States president announced an immediate prohibition on White House access for these news organizations, warning that other media outlets he describes as spreading misinformation may be subject to similar restrictions.

stories.title: Equipe de France : Zinédine Zidane dévoile sa première liste, sans Tchouaméni ni Thuram

en.title: France Team: Zinédine Zidane unveils first squad list, without Tchouaméni and Thuram
en.summary: France's new coach Zinédine Zidane announced his first squad on September 18 for two weeks of preparation at Clairefontaine ahead of four Nations League matches later that month. The roster includes several new players such as Estéban Lepaul, Andy Diouf, and Jérémy Jacquet.

stories.title: REPLAY - Zidane dévoile sa première liste en tant que sélectionneur de l'équipe de France

en.title: Zidane unveils first squad list as France team coach
en.summary: Zinédine Zidane presented his initial 23-player roster on September 18 as France's new coach, excluding midfielder Aurélien Tchouaméni and forward Marcus Thuram but including five new additions. Kylian Mbappé will retain the captain's armband.

stories.title: Equipe de France : Zinédine Zidane dévoile sa première liste avec Estéban Lepaul et Lucas Da Cunha mais sans N'Golo Kanté ni Aurélien Tchouameni

en.title: France Team: Zinédine Zidane unveils first squad with Estéban Lepaul and Lucas Da Cunha but without N'Golo Kanté and Aurélien Tchouaméni
en.summary: Zinédine Zidane called up 23 players for his debut gathering as coach, with Nations League matches scheduled against Turkey, Italy, and a double fixture against Belgium.

stories.title: Attaques hybrides russes, Ormuz et carburants, présidentielle 2027… Ce qu’il faut retenir de la conférence de presse d’Emmanuel Macron

en.title: Russian hybrid attacks, Strait of Hormuz and fuel, 2027 presidential race... What to remember from Emmanuel Macron's press conference
en.summary: The French president held a meeting Friday with representatives from various political parties at the Élysée to discuss the international situation and ongoing conflicts.

stories.title: OPINION. « 2027 : quel espace pour notre souveraineté narrative ? » (François Tron)

en.title: OPINION. "2027: what space for our narrative sovereignty?" (François Tron)
en.summary: The article argues that the state must respond to digital transformation, and that new media regulation is needed to protect French media outlets, their funding, and the nation's ability to shape its own collective narrative.

stories.title: L’ESA met Iceye et Leonardo en compétition dans la conception du système satellite européen de reconnaissance

en.title: ESA puts Iceye and Leonardo in competition for designing European reconnaissance satellite system
en.summary: The European Space Agency awarded two separate contracts to a consortium led by Iceye and to Leonardo Group to develop the architecture for Europe's future Earth Observation Governmental Service satellite system.

stories.title: Comment retrouver les dossiers thématiques et séries de La Tribune ?

en.title: How to find La Tribune's thematic files and series?
en.summary: La Tribune's thematic section, accessible from the homepage and at latribune.fr/dossiers, compiles investigations, analyses and interviews on major issues and will host summer 2026 series and other event coverage.

stories.title: Livraison de petits colis : Gofo tisse sa toile en Europe depuis Lyon

en.title: Small parcel delivery: Gofo expands its network in Europe from Lyon
en.summary: Gofo, a company with Chinese shareholders, quietly arrived in France in 2025 and is expanding its operations with a new sorting center near Lyon to compete in the small parcel market across Europe and Asia.

stories.title: Face à la Russie, Emmanuel Macron veut renforcer le plan de défense contre les drones

en.title: Facing Russia, Emmanuel Macron wants to strengthen the drone defense plan
en.summary: Emmanuel Macron has ordered France to increase its defensive posture against suspected Russian drone attacks that have recently targeted Europeans.
